comment: Documentation versions, newest first. A version is a minor release (x.y); its patch releases (x.y.Z) are listed in `releases`, oldest first, and are documented inside it. `status` is `current` for the version of the newest release and `previous` for older ones. `source` is the kividb git tag the newest release of the version is built from. `withdrawn` maps a release that was withdrawn to why, in Markdown; it stays listed, with that note. `notes` maps a release to a note, in Markdown, that the What changed page gives above its changes.

notes.1.2.0: Released on 3 November 2026. It fixes two security issues that affect 1.1.3: [GHSA-6rw7-4fcr-r6j3](https://github.com/kividbio/kividb/security/advisories/GHSA-6rw7-4fcr-r6j3) (ACL key permissions bypassed through `SORT` patterns and multi-`STORE` destinations) and [GHSA-c4xj-63wm-4jj9](https://github.com/kividbio/kividb/security/advisories/GHSA-c4xj-63wm-4jj9) (credentials in `SLOWLOG`, `MONITOR` and the log). 1.1 gets no further release. [Upgrading from 1.1](get-started/upgrading.md#upgrading-from-11-to-12) says what to check before upgrading, and in what order.
notes.1.2.1: Released on 12 November 2026, a patch release of 1.2.0. It fixes two security issues: [GHSA-cg4w-p5w5-57w5](https://github.com/kividbio/kividb/security/advisories/GHSA-cg4w-p5w5-57w5) (commands that write only with some arguments, such as `GEORADIUS ... STORE` and `MIGRATE`, got past read-only ACL key permissions and the `@read` and `@write` categories, and were not held by `min-replicas-to-write`, the out-of-memory refusal or `aof-ack-after-write`) and [GHSA-qh83-449g-hwm5](https://github.com/kividbio/kividb/security/advisories/GHSA-qh83-449g-hwm5) (a deeply nested JSON document could crash the server). It also fixes the 1.2.0 known issues of reshards that could lose writes and replicas that could stop while they saved. **Upgrade the replicas first, then their master**: [Upgrading from 1.2.0 to 1.2.1](get-started/upgrading.md#upgrading-from-120-to-121) says what you will notice.
notes.1.2.2: Released on 13 November 2026, a patch release of 1.2.1 that fixes one security issue: [GHSA-8rm8-p5c5-g3mr](https://github.com/kividbio/kividb/security/advisories/GHSA-8rm8-p5c5-g3mr) (a multi-key write over a key past its time to live, with `MSET`, `MSETNX`, `JSON.MSET`, or a `MULTI`/`EXEC` of plain `SET`s after `WATCH`, could make the server stop answering, until a restart, when a search index existed and was being changed at the same time). Servers without a search index, and 1.1, were not affected. Nothing else changes. **Upgrade from 1.2.x, the replicas first, then their master**: [Upgrading from 1.2.1 to 1.2.2](get-started/upgrading.md#upgrading-from-121-to-122).

notes.1.1.3: A security release: it fixes [GHSA-58x5-jq4h-h6rr](https://github.com/kividbio/kividb/security/advisories/GHSA-58x5-jq4h-h6rr) (a TLS client that does not finish its handshake holds up the others), [GHSA-rhrj-pgm8-2686](https://github.com/kividbio/kividb/security/advisories/GHSA-rhrj-pgm8-2686) (writes to a key past its time to live are lost) and [GHSA-pjrr-m43f-m5g3](https://github.com/kividbio/kividb/security/advisories/GHSA-pjrr-m43f-m5g3) (overlapping AOF checkpoints, or a crash during one, lose acknowledged writes), and the other bugs its [changelog](https://github.com/kividbio/kividb/blob/v1.1.3/CHANGELOG.md) lists. [`maxclients`](reference/configuration.md#maxclients) is now enforced, and taken in the configuration file. **Upgrade the replicas first, then their master** ([Replication](guides/replication.md#upgrading)).

withdrawn.1.1.1: Under a high rate of writes with a TTL, background expiry falls behind and memory grows without bound ([#87](https://github.com/kividbio/kividb/issues/87)). Use 1.1.2 or later: patch releases of 1.1.0 that include everything in 1.1.1 and the fix. The 1.1.1 images and packages are still published, so that a pinned deployment does not break.
